description: Engineering calibration bands for Evidence Runner v0. These bands validate metric completeness, stability, and obvious runtime abnormalities; they are not market-research acceptance targets.

spread.description: Mean bid/ask spread or derived snapshot price gap.

depth.description: Mean visible bid plus ask depth from order book snapshots.

turnover.description: Executed trade value aggregated over the calibration run.

volatility.description: Population standard deviation of one-step bar returns.

fill_rate.description: Filled or partially filled order count divided by status-observed orders.

cancel_rate.description: Cancelled order count divided by status-observed orders.

buy_sell_ratio.description: Buy order count divided by sell order count.

holding_period.description: Mean observed retail holding period in bars.

retail_family_mix.description: Observed retail family diversity proxy, normalized to 0-1.

order_lifespan.description: Mean order lifespan from creation to fill, cancel, or expiry.
